title: Chunk
description: Unit of text produced by pipelines/ and consumed by agent/ (retrieval). One record per chunk.
$comment: Frozen on 2026-10-15 (W1-D4-DAT-1, decisions in issue #7). Change only through an issue approved by the maintainer (DAT).

doc_id.description: Stable identifier within the source, e.g. an arXiv id.

source.description: Origin of the record; values follow ADR 0003.

text.description: Text that is embedded and shown as the snippet. arXiv: title and abstract.

published_at.description: Date of the first public version (arXiv: versions[0].created); Wikipedia: revision date.

license.description: Licence of `text`, not of the full paper. arXiv title/abstract: CC0-1.0; Wikipedia: CC BY-SA 4.0.

embedding_model.description: Name of the model that produced the stored vector.
